items.title: Hentoff Nat — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Let’s focus on Frankie Newton... [INTERVIEWEE] Yes.

ctx.x: Also, he used to give trumpet lessons on the side. Some people – some of the kids couldn’t afford it. He said to me, “How could I charge anybody who didn’t have the money if they wanted to study music?”
Let’s focus on Frankie Newton, because outside of the fact that Eric Hobsbawn took a nom de plum from him – I believe he wrote under the name Francis Newton.
